description: Routing completion and cart sheet UI. Replaces the skeleton app_router.dart with a fully working kaisel typed router (HomeRoute, PostRoute, CartRoute), fixes lib/main.dart's dispose method stub, and implements the CartSheet full-page and CartItemTile — so the app has a navigable skeleton before FEAT-003 adds the heavy feature pages. Depends on FEAT-001 (CartManager, CartOrder, CartAddon, CartItem must exist).
steps: Step 1 — Fix lib/main.dart dispose method. The existing `_BootStrapState.dispose` has a compile error (`errors.c` is incomplete). Replace the dispose body with: `widget.errors.close(); super.dispose();`. Import nothing new — BootstrapErrorReporter.close() already exists.

Step 3 — Create lib/features/cart/cart_item_tile.dart. StatelessWidget `CartItemTile` with `final CartItem item` constructor param.
  Layout: ListTile-like Row with:
    • Left: 60×60 image — use CachedNetworkImage if item.imageUrl != null, else a grey Container.
    • Middle (Expanded): Column with title text (style: bodyMedium), price text (style: bodySmall, color: cyanAccent), addon chip list (Wrap of small Chips for each addon name).
    • Right: Column with quantity stepper (Row: IconButton minus, Text quantity, IconButton plus) calling CartManager.instance.updateQuantity, and an IconButton(Icons.delete_outline) calling CartManager.instance.removeItem.
  Imports: package:flutter/material.dart, package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart, ../../core/cart/cart_manager.dart, ../../core/cart/cart_models.dart.

Step 4 — Create lib/features/cart/cart_sheet.dart. StatelessWidget `CartSheet`.
  Scaffold with:
    • AppBar: title 'Cart', leading back button `context.router<AppRoute>().pop()`.
    • Body: Watch cartSignal via `Watch` from signals_flutter (or use a StreamBuilder on cartSignal.toStream() — prefer direct: wrap build content in a `Builder` and read `CartManager.instance.cartSignal.value` reactively). Use a `Watch` widget from `package:signals_flutter/signals_flutter.dart` wrapping a Column:
      - if order.items.isEmpty: Center(child: Text('Your cart is empty')).
      - else: ListView.builder of CartItemTile.
    • BottomNavigationBar replaced by a bottom Padding with total price Text and an ElevatedButton('Checkout') that shows a SnackBar 'Checkout not yet implemented'.
  Imports: package:flutter/material.dart, package:kaisel/kaisel.dart, package:signals_flutter/signals_flutter.dart, ../../core/cart/cart_manager.dart, cart_item_tile.dart, ../../routing/app_router.dart.
  NOTE: signals_flutter is a transitive dependency of bloc_signals_flutter — check pub cache for it. If Watch is not available, use a StatefulWidget that subscribes to cartSignal.subscribe((v) => setState((){})). Prefer the Watch approach if available.

Step 5 — Create stub files for all pages that FEAT-003 will fill, so the router compiles now:
  • lib/features/grid/grid_page.dart — `import 'package:flutter/material.dart'; class GridPage extends StatelessWidget { const GridPage({super.key}); @override Widget build(BuildContext context) => const Scaffold(body: Center(child: Text('Grid — coming soon'))); }`
  • lib/features/product/product_page.dart — `import 'package:flutter/material.dart'; class ProductPage extends StatelessWidget { final String postUrl; const ProductPage({super.key, required this.postUrl}); @override Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(body: Center(child: Text('Product: $postUrl'))); }`
  These stubs will be overwritten by FEAT-003.
acceptance_criteria: `flutter build apk --debug` exits 0 — the app is buildable end-to-end.
appRouterConfig has initial: const HomeRoute() and the switch handles all three route types.
CartSheet uses CartManager.instance.cartSignal reactively (not a one-time snapshot).
CartItemTile renders image, title, price, and quantity stepper.
